description: This file implements the ActiveSessions class, which manages active CDM sessions, including creation, retrieval, and removal of sessions, with thread safety mechanisms.

classes.name: ActiveSessions
classes.description: Singleton class managing active CDM sessions with thread safety.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ActiveSessions.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new CDM session and adds it to the active sessions map.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an active session matching the provided key ID, incrementing its reference count.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a session from active sessions, deleting it if reference count reaches zero.
